description: Header file defining the TlsServerConnection class and its Delegate for handling server-side TLS connections in QUIC, including callback mechanisms for BoringSSL integration.

classes.name: TlsServerConnection
classes.description: Represents a server-side TLS connection handling class with callback support for BoringSSL.

classes.name: TlsServerConnection::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for server-specific callback implementations used by TlsServerConnection.

methods.name: CreateSslCtx
methods.description: Creates and configures an SSL_CTX suitable for server use with a ProofSource.

methods.name: SetCertChain
methods.description: Sets the certificate chain for the TLS connection.

methods.name: SetClientCertMode
methods.description: Configures the client certificate mode for the connection.

methods.name: UpdateCertVerifyCallback
methods.description: Updates the certificate verification callback based on current SSL config.
